Ident.description: An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

description:
One placed macro (doc 03 §7, doc 07 §2.7), record kind `macro_instance` (rank 46), in the file of its anchor
page: its provenance and "where used".

Links (`crates/ew-model/invariants.md` §4): `page` cascades (deleting the anchor page deletes the instance),
`members` unlinks (a deleted member leaves the list), `macro` forbids removing the macro copy.

$k.description: The kind name; always the first member.

members.description: Fragment-local ID → the record created from it, in insertion order.

value_set.description: The value set used, by name.

values.description: The values used, by variable name.

variant.description: The key of the variant placed.
